name: B10-0116/2026 (PfE) – Situation in Northeast Syria, the violence against civilians and the need to maintain a sustainable ceasefire
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Northeast Syria, the violence against civilians and the need to maintain a sustainable ceasefire
part_text:
This is a motion for a resolution, so it does not change any law. It states the Parliament's position and asks the European Union and its member states to do several things: protect Kurdish, Christian and Druze communities in Syria, keep up the fight against ISIS, send Syrian asylum seekers back, keep ISIS fighters out of Europe, and treat the Muslim Brotherhood as a terrorist group.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Syrians in the region and in Europe, EU aid spending, and EU asylum rules.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU institutions and member states, which decide whether to act.
